exposure: Cervical cerclage after first twin delivery for delayed interval delivery
outcome: Fetal/Neonatal outcomes (gestational age at delivery, mortality, neonatal aftermath)
cohort: Three patients with dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies who experienced delayed-interval delivery after the loss of the first twin, with cervical cerclage performed.
finding: Cervical cerclage after the delivery of the first twin was associated with prolonged pregnancy, potentially leading to improved gestational age and perinatal outcomes for the second twin.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 21.6 ± 2.9 weeks for the first fetuses and 24.8 ± 4.0 weeks for the second fetuses.
